title: ec2-arm64.yml: fork pull_request jobs run on self-hosted runner (repo-name gate only)
description: Security codereview pass-2 observation on yc6p (pre-existing, out of scope there): .github/workflows/ec2-arm64.yml triggers on pull_request and runs jobs on a self-hosted EC2 ARM64 runner gated only by github.repository == 'MarkAtwood/project-LICHEN' (lines ~6/18/76/93). Fork PRs satisfy that gate; mitigation currently relies on GitHub's require-approval setting for outside collaborators plus (now) the read-only GITHUB_TOKEN from yc6p. Known GitHub anti-pattern: self-hosted runner + pull_request trigger risks persistent runner compromise from PR code. Options: require environment approval, switch trigger to pull_request_target with no checkout of PR code, gate on author association (OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR), or move to GitHub-hosted runners. Human decision needed on runner policy; filing so it isn't lost.
